### Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(car)
library(lme4)
library(nlme)
library(DHARMa)
library(rgl)
library(remef)
```

### Load data and create factors
```{r}
representation_data = read.csv("~/These/data/meg_maestro/representation_analysis/seeg/corr_and_distance/representation_decoding.csv")
representation_data$subject = as.factor(representation_data$subject)
representation_data$electrode = as.factor(representation_data$electrode)
```

### Visulizations
```{r}
scatterplotMatrix(~correct+surprise+intrastim_corr+interstim_dist, data=representation_data)
scatterplot(correct~surprise, data=representation_data)
scatterplot(correct~intrastim_corr, data=representation_data)
scatterplot(correct~interstim_dist, data=representation_data)
scatterplot(intrastim_corr~surprise, data=representation_data)
scatterplot(interstim_dist~surprise, data=representation_data)
```

### Centering
```{r}
scale_columns = function(data, columns) {

  for (col in columns) {
    if (col %in% names(data)) {
      scaled_col <- as.vector(scale(data[[col]], scale=TRUE))
      data[[col]] <- scaled_col
    } else {
      warning(paste("Column", col, "not found in the dataframe. Skipping..."))
    }
  }

  return(data)
}

columns_to_scale = names(representation_data)[sapply(representation_data, is.numeric)]  # keep numeric columns
columns_to_scale = columns_to_scale[!columns_to_scale %in% c("X", "correct", "surprise")]
representation_data = scale_columns(representation_data, columns_to_scale)
```

### predict correct from representations
```{r}
model = glmer(correct ~ intrastim_corr + interstim_dist + (1 | subject) + (1 | subject:electrode), data = representation_data, family = binomial(link='logit'))
summary(model)

model = glmer(correct ~ intrastim_corr + interstim_dist + (1 | subject:electrode), data = representation_data, family = binomial(link='logit'))
summary(model)

model = glmer(correct ~ intrastim_corr + interstim_dist + (1 | subject), data = representation_data, family = binomial(link='logit'))
summary(model)

model = glmer(correct ~ intrastim_corr + (1 | subject), data = representation_data, family = binomial(link='logit'))
summary(model)
model = glmer(correct ~ interstim_dist + (1 | subject), data = representation_data, family = binomial(link='logit'))
summary(model)

model = glmer(correct ~ intrastim_corr + interstim_dist + (intrastim_corr + interstim_dist | subject), data = representation_data, family = binomial(link='logit'))
summary(model)
```


### decode surprise from representations
```{r}
model = glmer(surprise ~ intrastim_corr + interstim_dist + (1 | subject), data = representation_data, family = Gamma(link='log'))
summary(model)

model = lmer(surprise ~ intrastim_corr + interstim_dist + (1 | subject), data = representation_data)
summary(model)

model = lme(surprise ~ interstim_dist, random = ~ 1|subject, data = representation_data)
summary(model)

model = lm(surprise ~ intrastim_corr, data = representation_data)
summary(model)
model = lm(surprise ~ interstim_dist, data = representation_data)
summary(model)
```
